source_document: TNAU Crop Production Guide (Agriculture) 2020 & TNAU Department of Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry
disclaimer: Soil application of micronutrients must be done on soil test basis only. Do not mix zinc sulphate with phosphatic fertilizers.
spatial_sampling_note: Recommendation is valid for this sample; sample several spots of the field for representative accuracy.

interpretation.citation: TNAU CPG 2020, Soil Health and Nutrient Management Section, p. 18

deficient.advisory: Soil is deficient in available Zinc (< 1.2 ppm). Apply 25 kg Zinc Sulphate (ZnSO4) per hectare (10 kg/acre) as basal soil application. Alternatively, spray 0.5% Zinc Sulphate foliar spray with 0.5% lime at 30 and 45 days after sowing/transplanting.
deficient.application_method: Basal soil application or 0.5% foliar spray
deficient.caution: Do not mix Zinc Sulphate directly with DAP or other phosphatic fertilizers; apply separately to prevent zinc phosphate precipitation.

sufficient.advisory: Soil contains sufficient available Zinc (≥ 1.2 ppm). No external zinc application required.

interpretation.citation: TNAU CPG 2020, Secondary and Micronutrients Management, p. 19

deficient.advisory: Soil is deficient in available Sulphur (< 10.0 ppm). Apply 20 to 40 kg Sulphur per hectare through Gypsum (approx. 200–250 kg gypsum/ha, or 80–100 kg gypsum/acre) as basal application before sowing.
deficient.application_method: Basal broadcast and incorporate before sowing
deficient.caution: Gypsum also supplies valuable calcium which improves soil structure in alkaline and sodic soils.

sufficient.advisory: Soil contains adequate available Sulphur (≥ 10.0 ppm). No corrective sulphur application needed.

interpretation.citation: TNAU CPG 2020, Micronutrient Recommendations for Crops, p. 20

deficient.advisory: Soil is deficient in available Boron (< 0.5 ppm). Apply 10 kg Borax per hectare (4 kg/acre) as basal soil application, or apply 0.2% Borax foliar spray (or 0.1% Solubor) at pre-flowering and flower opening stage.
deficient.application_method: Basal soil application or 0.2% foliar spray
deficient.caution: Do not exceed recommended doses; boron has a narrow range between deficiency and crop toxicity.

sufficient.advisory: Soil contains sufficient available Boron (≥ 0.5 ppm). Additional boron is not needed.
